text:
tori: seeing a small but persistent rise in nvme io_qd on eu-central-1 ephemerals since 08:50. Attach latency for gpus has climbed and a few attaches timed out (3/200).

chen: can you paste the node logs? any pattern in block sizes?

tori: node gnode-euc-782 logs:```WARN nvme: io_queue_depth=212 state=pressure small_io_ratio=0.72
INFO cleaner: defer eviction due_to=io_pressure backlog=142 defer_count=46
ERR nvme: read retry=5 write retry=8 rc=EIO
```

oscar: looks like small-block delete churn. Did any bk jobs (RL or ML batch) spike around 08:45-08:55?

tori: yes RL batch launch at 08:46 across eu cluster, ~1200 attaches attempted in 4m window.

lena: immediate options: 1) delay remaining RL attaches by 10m, 2) pause non-critical scrubs, 3) bump cleaner concurrency and/or split cleaner pods to different nodes, 4) apply a temporary IO class QOS to lower delete priority.

oscar: I prefer pause scrubs + short attach delay. Cleaner concurrency bump helped last time but can increase write amplification if not careful.

chen: can we do a canary: pause scrubs only in eu-central for 15m and add a temporary tc qdisc that throttles small-block writes from janitor/cleaner to 250mbit? If metrics recover, revert.

tori: applying pause to scrub schedule for eu-central (via /ops/scrub-control): paused pattern=nightly region=eu-central duration=15m by=tori.

infra-bot: [alert] nvme_io_pressure_high on eu-central triggered at 2026-03-21T08:52:10Z. Incident created #INC-20260321-02.

chen: adding tc rule on node gnode-euc-782:```sudo tc qdisc replace dev nvme0 root fq_codel limit 1000 latency 50ms```

chen: verified rule present on 3 affected nodes.

oscar: monitoring: io_qd dropping 212 -> 130 in 90s, cleaner_deferred_count -> 12, attach timeouts reduced to 0/180.

lena: good. Follow-ups: - add a flag to the cleaner so it will not defer if backlog > 100 and instead escalate alert - schedule scrub windows with jitter to avoid large batch overlaps - add a metric for small_io_ratio per node and alert earlier.

chen: I'll file infra ticket and add heuristics to cleaner. tori keep an eye for 15m then unpause.

infra-bot: [resolve] nvme_io_pressure_high on eu-central cleared at 2026-03-21T09:03:05Z.
